data.one_liner: A Dart client for interacting with the Linux BlueZ Bluetooth stack via D-Bus.
data.what_it_does: It connects to the system BlueZ service, enumerates adapters and devices, and allows operations like discovery, pairing, and GATT communication. All interactions are performed over D-Bus on Linux platforms.
use_when: You need direct Bluetooth control on Linux desktops or embedded devices
You want to manage Bluetooth adapters, devices, and GATT services from Dart
avoid_when: Running on non‑Linux platforms (iOS, Android, Windows, macOS)
You require a cross‑platform Bluetooth solution
strengths: Thin wrapper around the official BlueZ D‑Bus API
Supports most BlueZ features including advertising, GATT, and agent registration
Pure Dart, no native plugins required
weaknesses: Linux‑only; will throw at runtime on other OSes
Relies on the dbus package, so D‑Bus must be available and correctly configured
